title: Built link
description: A canal or rail token on one printed edge. At most one link per edge, by anybody. Every link is cleared at the canal-to-rail transition.

a.description: One endpoint's board-location id. Undirected: consumers compare both orderings.

kind.description: Token type, always equal to the era it was built in. Canal links cost 3 and no coal; rail links cost 5 plus 1 coal, or 15 plus 2 coal and 1 beer for a double build.
